TooltipEqualiserSwitch: Turn the equaliser on or off
TooltipNormalisation: Loudness normalisation from ReplayGain tags or EBU R128 analysis
EffectDescriptionCrossfeed: Mixes part of each channel into the opposite one, as with speakers. Reduces the unnatural channel separation in headphones.
EffectDescriptionLoudness: Boosts bass and treble at low listening levels, following equal-loudness contours.
EffectDescriptionVirtualBass: Adds harmonics of low notes, so bass stays audible on speakers with limited bass response.
EffectDescriptionDynamicRange: Reduces the loudness difference between quiet and loud passages.
EffectDescriptionStereoWidth: Widens the stereo image without changing the sound in mono.
DropHint: Files or a folder can also be dragged onto the window.
PlaylistMissing: Playlist loaded. Skipped entries with missing files: {0}.
PlaylistEmpty: Playlist not loaded. None of the listed files exist.
PlaylistLoadFailed: The playlist cannot be loaded. Possible cause: the file is damaged or unavailable.
PlaylistSaveFailed: The playlist cannot be saved. Possible cause: the location is not accessible or the disk is full.
AudioFailure: Playback could not be started. It can be retried, or another device can be chosen.
HintMachineTranslation: The interface translations were machine-generated and may contain errors. Corrections can be reported in the project repository.
HintEffects: The automatic mode stops the moving background, disc and waveform while on battery or when animations are turned off in the system settings.
HintColours: Sets how strongly the cover colours tint the window background.
HintQueuePanel: The L key pins the panel in place. Double-clicking the panel edge restores the default width.
HintQueueHideDelay: A panel that never hides itself closes with the Esc key or a press outside it.
HintFormatBadge: Shows codec, bit depth, bitrate and sample rate next to the disc.
HintPlaceholder: The spiral replaces the cover for files that have none. The window background is built from its colours, as with a real cover.
DeviceIdle: The device is opened when playback first starts.
HintNormalisation: Normalises track loudness from ReplayGain tags, falling back to its own EBU R128 analysis.
HintLimiter: Guards against clipping after the equaliser adds gain.
HintLoudnessTarget: The level that track loudness is normalised to: −23 LUFS is the broadcast standard, −18 LUFS the ReplayGain reference level, −14 LUFS the level used by streaming services. A higher level leaves less headroom before clipping.
HintAlwaysAnalyse: Loudness is always measured by the app, even when the file has tags. A track's first play is not normalised.
HintQuality: Applies to files whose sample rate differs from the output device; higher quality reduces distortion at the cost of processor load, while “No filter” is the fastest and least accurate. Takes effect from the next track.
HintLatency: A smaller buffer shortens the delay but raises the risk of dropouts when the system is busy; the driver may settle on a different value.
LatencyUnknown: The value is read once the device is open.
HintRestoreSession: On start-up the app restores the queue and position from the previous session without starting playback. When this setting is off, the app starts with an empty queue but still saves it.
HintSeekStep: How far the left and right arrow keys move playback.
HintSoftPause: Pausing fades the sound out smoothly, and resuming fades it back in. Applies to files.
HintSceneMotion: Disc rotation and background motion apply to the window and the stage, spectrum fall only to the stage.
HintRadioRecentLimit: Number of stations on the recently played list.
HintRadioPlayAtStart: When the app opens in radio mode, it plays the last station right away.
SettingFileOpen: Files opened from outside the app
HintFileOpen: Applies to files opened outside the app: from the file manager, from the “Open with” menu, or dropped onto the window. Files chosen inside the app are always added to the end of the queue.
HintMediaKeys: The play, stop and track keys also work when the window is not active. On Linux the desktop handles them through the media panel, so this setting does not apply there.
HintSingleInstance: Files opened later are added to the queue of the running window, without starting a second instance. The change takes effect at the next start-up.
MediaPanelActive: Active. The track and playback controls are shown in the system media panel.
MediaPanelInactive: Unavailable. The system did not provide the panel when the app started.
MediaPanelUnsupported: This system provides no media panel.
AssociationsCurrent: The app is associated with audio files.
AssociationsStale: The associations point to a different location of the app. They can be refreshed with the “Add associations” button.
AssociationsAbsent: The app is not associated with audio files. Adding associations puts it on the “Open with” list for the current user only and does not change default apps.
AssociationsUnsupported: This system provides no file associations.
AssociationsFailed: The file associations were not saved. They remain unchanged.
UpdateCurrent: The installed version is up to date.
UpdateFailed: Cannot check for updates. There is no connection, or the service is not responding.
HintUpdateCheck: After start-up the app asks GitHub for the latest version number, at most once a day; the service receives the network address and the app version, and no data about played files. The “Check now” button works regardless of this setting.
DecodersSummary: MP3, FLAC and WAV: miniaudio. Ogg Vorbis: NVorbis. Opus: Concentus.
LicencesEmpty: The list of component licences is unavailable.
LicenceSummary: Cewka is released under the MIT licence. Avalonia, NVorbis, Concentus and ATL.NET: MIT. miniaudio: MIT-0. The Cantarell font: SIL Open Font License 1.1.
AudioFailureDevice: The output device could not be opened. It may have been disconnected or taken by another app.
AudioFailureLibrary: The audio library is missing from the app files. Playback requires reinstalling the app.
AudioFailureFallback: The chosen device could not be opened. Sound is going to the default device.
DeviceLostNotice: The output device was disconnected. Playback is paused.
DeviceFallbackNotice: The chosen device is unavailable. Sound is going to the default device.
TracksSkipped: Files skipped because they cannot be played: {0}.
TrackFailureFileMissing: The file no longer exists at its saved path.
TrackFailureAccessDenied: The file cannot be read: permission denied.
TrackFailureFileUnavailable: The file is temporarily unavailable. Another app may hold it, or its drive was disconnected.
TrackFailureDamagedFile: The file is damaged or does not match its extension.
TrackFailurePlaybackInterrupted: Reading the file stopped during playback.
DecoderFailureUnspecified: This file format cannot be played.
DecoderFailureUnrecognisedFormat: The file format was not recognised.
DecoderFailureOutOfScopeFormat: The WMA format is not supported.
DecoderFailureSystemCodecsUnavailable: The system codecs for AAC, M4A and ALAC are missing.
DecoderFailureCodecMissing: The system has no decoder for this file.
DecoderFailureCodecMissingLinux: GStreamer lacks a plugin to decode this file. For AAC, M4A and ALAC it comes with the gstreamer1.0-libav package.
DecoderFailureDamagedFile: The file is damaged or unreadable.
DecoderFailureNoAudioStream: The file contains no audio stream.
DecoderFailureUnsupportedChannelLayout: The channel layout of this file is not supported.
AssociationsFailedExecutable: The location of the app file could not be determined. The associations remain unchanged.
AssociationsFailedRegistry: The system registry refused to save the associations. They remain unchanged.
FolderReadFailed: The folder “{0}” could not be read, so its files were not added. It may have been deleted, or its drive disconnected.
SeekPositionHelp: Enter turns on seeking with the arrow keys.
TooltipEqualiserReset: Reset the equaliser: every band and the preamp to 0 dB
ShortcutEscape: Close the queue panel, leave full screen
HintSceneVisual: Appearance of the full screen view. The V key switches to the next visualisation, Shift+V to the previous one.
SceneMonoNote: Mono recording: the stereo display is a vertical line.
HintSceneNext: Shows the next track from the queue in full screen.
SettingKeepAwake: Keep the screen on during playback
HintKeepAwake: The screen does not turn off or dim while music plays in full screen.
HintSceneOled: The picture drifts slowly, fixed text dims after 3 minutes without input, and the disc and text swap sides with every track.
HintSceneTextSize: Applies to the title, artist, album and the next track card.
HintSceneText: Applies to Disc, Cover and radio. Above Spectrum, Waveform, Horizon and Aurora the text stays at the top.
HintSceneCycle: The V key skips a visualisation that is turned off; it can still be chosen under Full screen. Disc is always included.
HintSceneBackground: In Disc and Cover, in the colours of the cover, or of the logo for radio. With reduced motion they stand still.
HintEffectBlobs: Soft patches of colour drifting slowly across the background.
HintEffectGlow: Soft light behind the disc, pulsing gently with the music.
HintEffectTint: A gradient and vignette over the blurred cover.
HintEffectParticles: Small points of light rising slowly.
HintSceneMargin: Moves the picture away from edges a TV may crop. The margin is remembered separately for each screen.
HintSceneScreen: The screen the picture is shown on. A saved screen that is not connected is replaced by the window's screen.
SceneScreenLost: The screen used for full screen was disconnected. Full screen was closed.
SceneEdgeFitHint: The frame marks the edge of the picture. The left and right arrows change the margin; Enter or Esc finishes.
ShortcutSceneVisual: Full screen: next and previous visualisation
RadioAddressBlocked: The address is on the blocklist and will not be added.
RadioAddressInvalid: The address is not valid. Only http and https addresses are allowed.
RadioImportFailed: The station list file cannot be read.
RadioImportEmpty: No stations were found in the file.
RadioExported: The station list has been saved.
RadioExportFailed: The station list cannot be saved.
RadioFilesQueuedNotice: Files were added to the queue. The queue is available in Files mode.
RadioStationBlocked: The station is on the blocklist and will not be played.
RadioPrivacyBanner: Radio connects to broadcasters' servers, which see the IP address: they supply the stream and the station logos. Logo downloads and the radio itself can be turned off in Settings.
HintRadioEnabled: When off, the source switch and radio shortcuts are hidden and all radio connections stop.
HintRadioLogos: Logos are downloaded over a secure connection from broadcasters' servers and saved on disk. When off, a radio icon is shown instead.
HintRadioClearRecent: Removes the list of recently played stations from this computer.
RadioStationWithdrawn: The station was removed from the list at the broadcaster's request and will not be played.
RadioFailureNetwork: No network connection. Once the connection is restored, it is possible to try again.
RadioFailureNoResponse: The station is not responding. It is possible to try again later or choose another station.
RadioFailureGeo: The station is not available in this location. Another station can be chosen.
RadioFailureEnded: The station stopped broadcasting. It is possible to reconnect.
RadioFailureSecure: A secure connection to the station cannot be established. Another station can be chosen.
RadioFailureRefused: The station address is not allowed. Another station can be chosen.
RadioFailureNotStream: The address leads to a web page, not to a stream. The station address can be checked.
RadioFailureFormat: The stream format cannot be played. Another station can be chosen.
RadioFailureHls: The station broadcasts in HLS format, which is not supported yet. Another station can be chosen.
RadioFailureCodecWindows: The AAC stream cannot be played. The Media Feature Pack is required.
RadioFailureCodecLinux: The AAC stream cannot be played. The package {0} is required.
RadioFailureCodecOther: The AAC stream cannot be played. The system has no AAC decoder.
